qualification: Fixed-width private bidirectional disk table: position entries then original-ID entries, each64 bytes, total128*N. Little-endian CKFLOC01/generation16/rank8/ID8/source-offset8/source-wire4/role4/reserved4/CRC4. Query validates slot, fields, generation/role/schema/checksum/source bounds and matching opposite-half entry. Source store/factory/context pinned; no native authority, reopening, restart or authentication claim.

Full file/byte quota reservation before native creation; rollback on creation/cancellation/exception. Existing variable stores use the same private RAII file-slot implementation with zero initial bytes and retain per-append reservation behavior. Empty input verifies source End with no additional file/slot. Nonempty tables are explicitly initialized in <=64KiB advances, then build one bounded source page per advance.

Unique in-range original IDs and exactlyN source rows prove a complete permutation using initialized disk slots, with no in-memory directory-sized set/table. A test substitutes a duplicate ID in valid-checksum sorted source and requires rejection without partial output. Canonical expected sorted IDs are fixed3,6,2,4,5,7,1, not derived by querying the implementation.

Rank pages retain exact encoded payloads and stable IDs. Row-key lookup requires the original dataset row_scope; foreign/moved/zero/out-of-range keys and out-of-range ranks do no IO. Too-small source page budgets retry without revoking healthy owners. Table CRC/valid-CRC field corruptions, truncation/trailing bytes, source CRC errors, partial/zero/overcount IO, all unavailable native states, every build-advance cancellation, source-read cancellation and ready-IO error/cancellation/exception paths are exercised.

It validates233 returned rows and corresponding original IDs/sizes, five reverse ID-to-rank keys, End, quotas and closure. limitations: WP-01 remains in progress; WP-02 through WP-08 unstarted. Indexed pane provider/generation/filter/selection/acquisition integration, remaining destination preservation/collision capability work and broader native qualification remain required.

Same-lifetime private cache lookup, not native operation authority or authenticated persistent storage. find_row validates cached table entries and source state, not all source bytes or any native directory. Native enumeration, filesystem snapshot consistency and later pathname/object revalidation are independent.

One initialized fixed-width table proportional to directory size is on disk, not RAM. Builder keeps <=64KiB initialization storage or one bounded source page plus fixed entry buffers. Wire quotas constrain live logical reservations, not cumulative IO, physical allocation, kernel cache, process RSS or all handles. Factory root handles are outside byte-file slots.

Ready queries are worker IO: at most two fixed64-byte reads plus one bounded source page, with table/source size checks as documented. Already issued owners keep source/file and reservations after builder abandonment. Projection cancellation preserves a healthy source; actual source IO/corruption revokes it. Native calls may block.

100000 records are synthetic private-cache data; real-directory integration remains259 entries. No full-app UI latency/RSS or100000-real-directory claim. APFS/ext4/ReFS coverage does not finish network/removable/provider/full-disk/crash/different-account qualification.

Row namespaces survive sorting within one dataset and change with new datasets. Future UI request/generation gates and fresh native acquisition remain mandatory; lookup availability cannot bypass metadata-loss consent or preservation capability inspection.
